Opening a 𝟭𝟬𝟬% 𝗣𝗼𝘀𝘁𝗱𝗼𝗰𝘁𝗼𝗿𝗮𝗹 𝗥𝗲𝘀𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗰𝗵𝗲𝗿 & 𝗗𝗲𝘀𝗶𝗴𝗻 𝗘𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗼𝗿 𝗽𝗼𝘀𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 (3-year contract) at LUCA School of Arts (Belgium)

This role sits right at the intersection of design research, care, education, and European project development.

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂'𝗹𝗹 𝗱𝗼 𝘊𝘰𝘯𝘯𝘦𝘤𝘵 𝘳𝘦𝘴𝘦𝘢𝘳𝘤𝘩 & 𝘵𝘦𝘢𝘤𝘩𝘪𝘯𝘨: work closely with the Caring and Design Research cluster and teach within the European master Response-Able Futures.

𝘉𝘳𝘪𝘥𝘨𝘦 𝘭𝘰𝘤𝘢𝘭 & 𝘨𝘭𝘰𝘣𝘢𝘭: link local organizations and societal challenges in the region to international educational and research formats.

𝘎𝘦𝘯𝘦𝘳𝘢𝘵𝘦 𝘯𝘦𝘸 𝘰𝘱𝘱𝘰𝘳𝘵𝘶𝘯𝘪𝘵𝘪𝘦𝘴: drive the acquisition of European research and educational grants to strengthen long-term impact.

𝗪𝗵𝗼 𝘄𝗲 𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗳𝗼𝗿
* A PhD in a design-related discipline (product, interaction, game, visual design, architecture, etc.).
* A strong affinity for design & care.
* A balance between a hands-on, collaborative working style and a deeply reflective mindset.
* Good skills in project acquisition, academic writing, and stakeholder networking.

𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗼𝗳𝗳𝗲𝗿 Duration: 3 years (full-time, starting September 1, 2026). Location: Campus Genk, Belgium (hybrid, min. 3 days on campus).

Deadline to apply: August 15, 2026.

Interested or know someone who would be a great fit?
